<div style="text-align: center; margin-top: 20px;">
<p><strong>want to be notified for the next blog?</strong></p>
<form id="subscribe-form" style="display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 15px;">
<input type="email" id="email-input" placeholder="Enter your email address" name="email" required="" style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 4px; width: 250px;">
<button type="submit" style="padding: 8px 15px; background-color: #4c61afff; color: white; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;"> Submit </button>
</form>
<p id="status-msg" style="margin-top: 10px; font-size: 14px;"></p>
</div>

<script>
document.getElementById('subscribe-form').onsubmit = async (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const email = document.getElementById('email-input').value;
  const status = document.getElementById('status-msg');

  try {
    await fetch('https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbwiLfowDjs9RnqImj8XScuidlj9evB-UFI1IQmCFFhPerQulgeP1Y62BYyLgkG--it6/exec', {
      method: 'POST',
      mode: 'no-cors',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ email })
    });
    status.innerText = "Success!";
    document.getElementById('email-input').value = '';
  } catch (err) {
    status.innerText = "Error. Try again.";
  }
};
</script>
